name: @satspath/p2p
description: Resolve & serve SatsPath signed payment profiles peer-to-peer over the Holepunch stack (Hyperswarm/HyperDHT) with NAT hole-punching. Transport + Rust WASM signature verification — never moves funds.

scripts.build:wasm:cli: cargo build -p satspath-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/satspath_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg --target nodejs

notes.wasm: Crypto (secp256k1, SHA-256, canonical JSON) is provided by the Rust WASM module in pkg/. Run `npm run build:wasm` (requires wasm-pack) or `npm run build:wasm:cli` (requires wasm-bindgen-cli) to regenerate after changing crates/satspath-wasm.
